name: Ntando
atp: Grade 8 Term 4: Area and Perimeter (weeks 5-6), then Surface Area and Volume (weeks 6-7), 2026 ATP
persona: Starts with three misconceptions: mixes up area and perimeter, forgets the half in a triangle's area, and uses 2πr for a circle's area. Each one fades after the learner has been shown it a couple of times; by the end of the week most answers are right first time.

misconceptions.rect_perimeter: You multiply the two sides instead of adding all four.
misconceptions.square_perimeter: You multiply side by side (that is the area).
misconceptions.rect_area: You add the sides instead of multiplying.
misconceptions.square_area: You do 4 times the side (that is the perimeter).
misconceptions.triangle_area: You forget to halve: you do base times height.
misconceptions.missing_width_perimeter: You subtract the length from the perimeter once and stop.
misconceptions.circle_area: You use 2 times pi times r, or you use the diameter as the radius.
misconceptions.circumference: You use pi times r squared.
misconceptions.convert: You multiply by 100 instead of 10 000 for square units.
misconceptions.square_from_perimeter: You give the perimeter back as the area.
